evidence.title: Authentication with a magic link | Patterns Catalogue

name: Design Patterns Catalogue
summary: Catalogue of 67 design patterns for building trusted services, from sign-in and consent to responsible AI.
description: IF's catalogue documents patterns for designing services that earn trust. Patterns are grouped into categories such as signing in, giving and removing consent, getting and giving access to data, security checks, and understanding and influencing decisions (AI); each pattern page gives a description, advantages, limitations, examples and related patterns.
contains: 24 patterns for AI systems (show confidence, copilot with an AI, model provenance …)
sign-in, consent, data access and security patterns
each pattern: description, advantages, limitations, examples, related patterns
